name: harness-loops
description: The loops that build against a harness rubric: /orchestrate, /review-loop, /iterate and /skill-loop, the critic, scorer, optimizer and skill-improver agents, the loop-gate that checks every seat's output, the Pi develop-phase runner, and the optional TypeSafe Jev classifier (round-to-round finding dedupe and a per-prompt skill/model-tier router; off without a TYPESAFE_API_KEY).
